java.head: 38fe96a27b7c33f5a51c3e350a45bf750f979429
java.note: Canonical free generator implementation is on #2113; the safe static class generator slice is stacked in #2117. Both source heads are zero-step NOT_EXECUTED. Instance generator methods remain fail-closed until receiver lifetime is continuation-safe.

llvm.head: 5ca0ff0b5cd09edc1cca8dd64839c53f01266a89
llvm.note: Native generator frame/continuation lowering is not implemented. The current-main hardening PR gives canonical generator-v1 spellings one compiler-owned diagnostic and native CTest rejection gates.

wasm.head: f1e257148f76becd6fc958533ed9dfb17e12124b
wasm.note: Language support is gated by the pinned real LLVM compiler. The current-main hardening PR requires the real compiler-owned generator-v1 rejection and rechecks compiler identity after each negative case.

dotnet.note: Native AOT bootstrap rejects canonical and legacy generator syntax with an explicit compiler-owned diagnostic before CIL emission.

js.note: Scalar-v1 and program-v2 have an auto-discovered fail-closed regression for canonical sync, async and suspend generator-v1 syntax until real ESM lowering exists.
